title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
summary: Return the number of nodes on a longest path from the root to a leaf.
statement: Return the number of nodes on a longest path from the root to a leaf. An empty tree has depth zero. Count the root and leaf when the path is nonempty.

examples.explanation: The path through 3 to 5 has three nodes.
The root is also a leaf.

hints: Conceptual: The depth of a node depends on how many ancestors precede it.
Directional: Process the tree level by level or carry a depth with each node.
Implementation: Start a nonempty root at depth one. Give each child its parent's depth plus one and keep the maximum.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time. A level-by-level traversal uses O(w) auxiliary space for maximum level width w.
